sources.title: Qwen 3.6 35B A3B & MTP: 7.8x Speedup with Frozen Backbones
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.6 35B A3B, an April 2026 release, is a high-performance Mixture-of-Experts reasoning model optimized for efficient inference on constrained hardware.
